items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Nat Cole did, you know as they say, “It don't cost you nothing,” ... she used to do a Nat Cole segment ... Or that record with Nat Cole and Buddy Rich

ctx.x: No. I think Nat Cole did, you know as they say, “It don't cost you nothing,” and it'd be really nice if more people would.
